title: Measurement Integrity in Peer Prediction: A Peer Assessment Case Study
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not contain a benchmark that measures any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on evaluating the 'measurement integrity' and 'robustness against strategic reporting' of peer prediction mechanisms in the context of academic peer assessment.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion, faith, or any related topics. Therefore, there are no findings related to religion.
